sources.author: Mobile
patch_list: Stops AppsFlyer, Snowplow, Datadog, and Firebase Analytics.
Removes the app's access to your location while it is closed or in the background.
Stops the app from scanning for Bluetooth devices and beacons, and hides paired devices.
Lets Android darken the app while the phone is in dark mode. Android picks the colors, so some screens may look different from a designed dark theme.
Stops the Play Store from replacing the patched app with the official version.
Lets the patched app start by skipping Google's Pairip license check.
Hides the cell towers your phone sees from the app.
Gives the app a random Android ID and a zeroed advertising ID.
Hides an active VPN from the app's checks on the phone.
Hides nearby Wi-Fi networks and the name of your network from the app.
Keeps the app from reading your location, even when location access is allowed.
Hides your mobile carrier from the app, or reports a carrier name you choose.
Opens store links without affiliate tags or click tracking. RetailMeNot cash back needs those, so cash back stops working.
